armyRules.name: Stoic Resilience
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion is built to be the last thing standing and has forgotten how to be the first to move. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Cool, but it may not Rush and it subtracts 1 from its Charge rolls.

armyRules.name: Siege Engineers
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Imperial Fists gunners are taught to reduce a wall one stone at a time. Shooting Attacks made by a unit with this rule ignore the Hit Test penalty for the target being in Cover, but the unit subtracts 1 from its Hit Tests against Flyers and against units that Rushed in their last turn.

armyRules.name: Wall Captains
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Dorn's officers hold ground by standing on it. A Character with this rule adds 1 to its Leadership, and any friendly unit it has joined is never worse than Cool 7, but the Character loses 1 Movement.

wargear.name: Bastion plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Extra ceramite slabs bolted over the plate of a man who will not be moved. The model gains +1 Toughness and loses 1 Movement.

wargear.name: Rampart standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A banner planted in the ground and defended to the last. Every model in the unit gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Range-finder array
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A pintle-mounted auspex and ranging lasers, calibrated to the yard on a wall the crew has measured a hundred times. Every model in the unit gains +1 Ballistic Skill.

wargear.name: Pavise stakes
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Sharpened iron stakes driven into the ground before the line to break any charge. Gives the unit Anti-Charge Stakes.

wargear.name: Praetorian seal
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A seal of Dorn's household, said to steady any unit that sees it. Gives the model Unshaken Seal.

wargear.name: Warden's targeter
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A rangemark projector that paints a wall for every gun behind it. Gives the model Warden's Mark.

wargear.name: Wall-breaker gauntlets
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Gauntlets built to tear the doors from fortress gates. Gives the model Wall-Breaker's Grasp.

wargear.name: Phalanx pennant
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A narrow pennant that tells each warrior where his neighbour stands. Gives the model Closed Ranks.

wargear.name: Fortress-lamp cluster
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bank of floodlights and rangefinding lamps lit on the hull. Gives the vehicle Lamp-Lit Targeting.

wargear.name: Bastion plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Extra slabs of vault-grade armour welded across the glacis. Gives the vehicle Layered Plating and +1 Front armour.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a siege-pattern weapon
The Templar Champion may take a Templar greatblade
Up to three models may wear Bastion plate
The unit may carry a Rampart standard
The unit may fit a Range-finder array
Praetorian regalia: may take up to two
The unit may plant Pavise stakes
The Sergeant may carry a Phalanx pennant
Up to two Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
Up to two Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
The Sergeant may take a Bastion sledge

modifiers.text: Bolter drill, rank on rank: +1 BS, -1 M.
Phalanx Warders stand as one: +1 LD, -1 I.
Templars close for the kill: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Dorn's own Huscarls strike hard and aim poorly: +1 A, -1 BS.
Siege-hardened hulls, slow to traverse: +1 HP, -1 BS.

rules.name: Shield Wall
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Unmoved Phalanx). A unit with this rule that did not move in its last Movement phase gains Feel No Pain (6+) against Shooting Attacks and automatically passes Cool Checks.

rules.name: Pre-sighted Arcs
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Fire from the Ramparts). The engineers have measured every yard. A unit with this rule that did not move in its Movement phase adds +1 to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Sworn Crusaders
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Oath of the Templars). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Charge rolls. If an enemy unit is within 12" at the start of its Assault phase, it must declare a Charge against the closest one.

rules.name: Household Guard
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Praetorian Retinue). The household is not frightened by anything it has not already faced. A unit with this rule ignores the effects of Fear (X), cannot be Pinned and adds +1 to its Cool Checks.

rules.name: Anti-Charge Stakes
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy units that charge a unit with this rule subtract 1 from their Charge rolls.

rules.name: Unshaken Seal
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, the bearer's unit may ignore one Tactical Status (Pinned, Suppressed or Stunned) when it is applied.

rules.name: Warden's Mark
rules.text: Legacy house rule. At the start of each Shooting phase choose one enemy unit within 24" of the bearer. Friendly Imperial Fists Shooting Attacks against it gain Breaching (6+) until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Wall-Breaker's Grasp
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer's melee attacks against Vehicles and Fortifications gain Armourbane.

rules.name: Closed Ranks
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Cool Checks while every model in it is within 2" of the Sergeant.

rules.name: Lamp-Lit Targeting
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The vehicle's Shooting Attacks ignore the Hit Test penalty for the target being in Cover.

rules.name: Layered Plating
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The vehicle's Front armour value is increased by 1.

rites.name: The Unmoved Phalanx
rites.flavor: Dorn set a line on the map and told his sons that the enemy would pay for every yard of it.
benefits: Phalanx Warder Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (2).
Phalanx Warders gain Shield Wall: if they did not move in their last Movement phase they gain Feel No Pain (6+) against Shooting Attacks and automatically pass Cool Checks.
limitations: At least one Phalanx Warder Squad is required.
No Fast Attack units, no Antigrav units and no Cavalry.

modifiers.text: The Unmoved Phalanx: Line (2), Shield Wall.

require.note: Bring at least one Phalanx Warder Squad.

rites.name: Fire from the Ramparts
rites.flavor: Every wall is a gun platform if the engineers have been given a week.
benefits: Tactical Support, Heavy Support and Veteran Heavy Support Squads may fill Troops slots.
Those squads and Rapier and Tarantula Batteries gain Pre-sighted Arcs: a unit that did not move add +1 to the Hit Tests of their Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least one Techmarine is required.
No Heavy Assault or Fast Attack units, and at most one Transport or Heavy Transport.

modifiers.text: Fire from the Ramparts: Pre-sighted Arcs.

require.note: A Techmarine must oversee the works.

limit.note: At most one Transport or Heavy Transport.

rites.name: Oath of the Templars
rites.flavor: Before Dorn gave them a wall to defend, they were bred to carry the war into someone else's house.
benefits: Templar Brethren may fill Troops slots and gain Sworn Crusaders: they add +1 to Charge rolls.
Templar Brethren add +1 Initiative on a turn they charge.
limitations: Sigismund or a Praetor of any kind must lead the army.
At least two Templar Brethren squads are required.
Templar Brethren must declare a Charge against the closest enemy unit within 12" when able.
No Heavy Assault, Armour or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Oath of the Templars: Sworn Crusaders.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

require.note: Bring at least two Templar Brethren squads.
Sigismund or a Praetor must lead the Templars.

rites.name: The Praetorian Retinue
rites.flavor: The Emperor's Huscarls follow no banner but Dorn's, and Dorn's banner is the Wall.
benefits: Huscarl Terminator Retinues may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Huscarls gain Household Guard: they ignore Fear (X), cannot be Pinned and add +1 to their Cool Checks.
limitations: At least one Huscarl Terminator Retinue is required.
No Cavalry, no Recon units and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: The Praetorian Retinue: Line (1), Household Guard.

require.note: Bring at least one Huscarl Terminator Retinue.
